run_final_processing_pipeline: run the final processing pipeline on a web document dataset synced from S3
remove_duplicated_images: remove duplicate images from a list of texts, images, and metadata by URL
compute_spam_word_ratio: compute the ratio of spam words in a given text string
remove_spam_paragraphs: remove paragraphs with a high spam word ratio from a list of texts
replace_images_by_urls: replace image objects in a dataset with their corresponding source URLs
